name: Football
summary: Football is a text-based football game played against the computer. On each play, the player picks from a menu of options, and the menu depends on whether the player has the ball. On offense, the choices are Run, Pass, Sweep, Screen Pass, Long Pass, Draw Play, Punt and Fieldgoal. On defense, they are Normal, Hold, Blitz, Intercept and Block. The chosen play and a random element together decide the result and the new state of the game. The game has no multiplayer mode.
